## Biography

An ordinary star. A lone planet. And something that should not exist.

The Thuecheae MT-Q e5-8 System was unremarkable until Commander LilacLight's scan detected the cold mass: carrier scale, no power, drifting toward the Praei-two boundary. The DW3 expedition diverted. Elaine Howard and Jacky Hew boarded the vessel. They found GalCop-era hybrid drive technology, nanite-compound residue, crew remains fused to bulkheads. The logs suggested evacuation by T-9. Nadya Holdstock connected the technology to ancient patterns.

The system itself is innocent. A K-type primary, a rocky world, nothing on charts to suggest danger. But danger does not announce itself with stellar phenomena. Sometimes it drifts quietly on a lazy vector, waiting for someone to look closely enough to notice it should not be there.
